# fabricext_item_share_gate (Resource)

!> **Warning:** **Experimental Provider**: The `fabricext` provider is published in a pre-`v1.0.0` experimental state to facilitate automated packaging and supply-chain verification. For core workspace and item management, use the official Microsoft [`microsoft/fabric`](https://registry.terraform.io/providers/microsoft/fabric/latest) provider.

~> **Note:** For end-to-end guidance and real-world multi-persona security configurations, see the [Access Control Playbook](../guides/access_control_playbook.md).

Declarative verification waiter that polls the Microsoft Fabric Admin API (`GET /v1/admin/workspaces/{workspaceId}/items/{itemId}/users`) until a designated principal holds the expected permissions on an item. It has **no write path**; it never grants or revokes remote permissions.

## Example Usage
```terraform
resource "fabricext_item_share_gate" "warehouse_connect" {
  workspace_id         = "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001"
  item_id              = "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000002"
  principal_id         = "11111111-1111-1111-1111-111111111111"
  principal_type       = "Group"
  expected_permissions = ["Read"]
  match_type           = "subset"

  timeouts {
    create = "60m"
    read   = "10m"
    update = "60m"
    delete = "1m"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `expected_permissions` (Set of String) Set of expected permissions that the principal must hold on the item (e.g., `["Read"]` or `["Read", "ReadData"]`).
- `item_id` (String) The UUID of the Microsoft Fabric item.
- `principal_id` (String) The Microsoft Entra Object ID (UUID) of the principal expected to hold access.
- `workspace_id` (String) The UUID of the Microsoft Fabric workspace containing the item.

### Optional

- `match_type` (String) Matching strategy: `subset` asserts that the principal holds at least the expected permissions (default); `exact` asserts an exact match of permissions.
- `principal_type` (String) Optional principal type filter (`User`, `Group`, `ServicePrincipal`, `ServicePrincipalProfile`, `EntireTenant`).
- `timeouts` (Block, Optional) Timeout configuration for verification operations. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--timeouts))
- `type` (String) Optional item type for route disambiguation (e.g., `Warehouse`, `Lakehouse`, `SQLDatabase`, `SQLEndpoint`, `Report`).

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Composite identifier in the format `{workspace_id}/{item_id}/{principal_id}`.

<a id="nestedblock--timeouts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `timeouts`

Optional:

- `create` (String) Timeout for waiting on item share verification during create (e.g. '60m'). Defaults to 60m.
- `delete` (String) Timeout for delete state cleanup (e.g. '1m'). Defaults to 1m.
- `read` (String) Timeout for reading item share access details (e.g. '10m'). Defaults to 10m.
- `update` (String) Timeout for waiting on item share verification during update (e.g. '60m'). Defaults to 60m.
## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:
```shell
# Import an existing item share gate by composite identifier {workspace_id}/{item_id}/{principal_id}
terraform import fabricext_item_share_gate.warehouse_connect 00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001/00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000002/11111111-1111-1111-1111-111111111111
```
